name: worldlabs-mcp
description: Generate explorable 3D worlds from text, images, and video using the World Labs Marble API. Supports Gaussian splat output (SPZ), collision mesh (GLB), panorama, and thumbnail assets.

multi_image_to_world.description: Generate 3D worlds from multiple images at azimuth angles

local_file_upload.description: Upload local files and generate worlds end-to-end

operation_polling.description: Poll and wait for async generation operations

world_management.description: List and retrieve world details and asset URLs
